gloss: oral medicine; medicine taken by mouth

definitions.gloss: oral medicine; medicine taken by mouth
definitions.explanation: Any medicine that is swallowed, such as tablets, capsules, powders, or liquid medicine. Distinguished from topical, injectable, or suppository forms.

examples.japanese: {飲|の}み{薬|ぐすり}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{飲|の}み{薬|ぐすり}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{食後|しょくご}→食後：09499_shokugo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{飲|の}んで→飲む：00322_nomu⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please take this medicine after meals.

examples.japanese: ⟦{塗|ぬ}り{薬|ぐすり}→塗り薬：17374_nurigusuri⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{飲|の}み{薬|ぐすり}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{両方|りょうほう}→両方：01750_ryouhou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{処方|しょほう}→処方：05976_shohou⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I was prescribed both a topical ointment and oral medicine.

notes:
FORMS:
Compound of ⟦{飲|の}む→飲む：00322_nomu⟧ (to drink/swallow) + ⟦{薬|くすり}→薬：00793_kusuri⟧ (medicine), with rendaku changing くすり to ぐすり.

FORMS OF ORAL MEDICINE:
- ⟦{錠剤|じょうざい}→錠剤：17290_jouzai⟧: tablets
- ⟦カプセル→カプセル：22926_kapuseru⟧: capsules
- ⟦{粉薬|こなぐすり}→粉薬：27515_konagusuri⟧: powdered medicine
- ⟦シロップ→シロップ：21577_shiroppu⟧: syrup

CONTRAST WITH OTHER MEDICINE TYPES:
- {飲|の}み{薬|ぐすり}: oral medicine (swallowed)
- ⟦{塗|ぬ}り{薬|ぐすり}→塗り薬：17374_nurigusuri⟧: topical medicine/ointment
- ⟦{目薬|めぐすり}→目薬：09714_megusuri⟧: eye drops
- ⟦{注射|ちゅうしゃ}→注射：01665_chuusha⟧: injection
- {座薬|ざやく}: suppository

FORMAL EQUIVALENT:
⟦{内服薬|ないふくやく}→内服薬：22643_naifukuyaku⟧ is the medical/formal term for oral medicine, commonly seen on prescriptions and pharmacy labels. {飲|の}み{薬|ぐすり} is the everyday conversational term.
